body: Design one presentation board for the fictional cafe {{name}}. Develop a coherent identity using {{palette}} and {{mood}}. Show its primary logo, takeaway cup, food carton, shopping bag, menu, table card and three compact campaign applications. Keep the same mark and typography across every mockup. Arrange the objects by function on a clean editorial grid with readable supplied labels.

Supply a fictional brand name, palette and mood; an existing logo is optional.
